records.before: ಮಹಾಭಾಗನೇ, ಅಲ್ಲಿ ವೇದಘೋಷಗಳಿಂದ ನಿನದಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದ ನಾನಾ ಮುನಿಗಳ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಸುಂದರವಾದ ನಿವಾಸಗಳನ್ನು ನಾನು ಕಂಡೆನು. ॥೨೯॥
records.source_reading: तत्र नानामुनीनां च वत्साः परमशोभनाः । मया दृष्टा महाभाग वेदघोषनिनादिताः ॥२९॥
records.notes: Actual original reads वत्साः, not a clear वासाः. Existing ನಿವಾಸಗಳು is a contextual dwelling interpretation supported by the ashram setting and following fire-ritual/tree descriptions, not a diplomatic reading of a dwelling noun. Retain provisionally with lexical/source hold. Do not introduce “calves” mechanically or claim the scan fixes the anomalous noun.

records.before: ಸಾಂಖ್ಯಬ್ರಹ್ಮವು ವಿದೇಹವನ್ನು ಧರಿಸಿರುವುದೆಂದು ಹೇಳಲಾಗಿದೆ, ಪುತ್ರನೇ. ವೇದದಲ್ಲಿ ಕರ್ಮಜ್ಞಾನವನ್ನು ತ್ವಂಪದಾತ್ಮಕವೆಂದು ಹೇಳಲಾಗಿದೆ. ॥೫೩॥
records.source_reading: सांख्यं ब्रह्मेति यत्प्रोक्तं विदेहधारकं सुत । कर्मज्ञाने तु वेदे च कथिते ते तदात्मके ॥५३॥
records.notes: The second half has कर्मज्ञाने/कथिते/ते/तदात्मके with dual forms, and no explicit त्वंपद. Replace only the current second sentence with the supplied source-term-preserving sentence. Do not resolve the antecedent of tad or treat the technical transliteration as a completed doctrinal explanation. First sentence unchanged. Full finalized replacement remains null.

records.before: ಸಮಬ್ರಹ್ಮವನ್ನು ತತ್ಪದಾತ್ಮಕವೆಂದು ಹೇಳಿರುವುದನ್ನು ತಿಳಿ. ಅವ್ಯಕ್ತವಾದ ಸಹಜಬ್ರಹ್ಮವನ್ನು ನೇತಿರೂಪವೆಂದು ತಿಳಿಯಬೇಕು. ॥೫೪॥
records.source_reading: समं ब्रह्मेति जानीहि कथितं नंदनात्मकम् । अव्यक्तं सहजं ब्रह्म ज्ञातव्यं नेतिरूपकम् ॥५४॥
records.notes: Actual original clearly reads नंदनात्मकम्. Current ತತ್ಪದಾತ್ಮಕ is not supported by these pixels. Replace only the first sentence with the source-term-preserving proposal. Nandana meaning and whether the printed term itself is defective remain unresolved; do not silently turn it into tatpada or ananda. The second sentence is unchanged. Full finalized replacement remains null.

records.before: ಸಾಂಖ್ಯರಿಗೆ ಸಿದ್ಧಿಯನ್ನು ಕೊಡುವವನು ಗಜಾನನನೆಂದು ತಿಳಿಯಬೇಕು. ಅವನು ಲೋಭಾಸುರನ ಸಂಹಾರಕ; ಇಲಿಯ ವಾಹನವುಳ್ಳವನೆಂದು ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧನಾಗಿದ್ದಾನೆ. ॥೮॥
records.source_reading: गजाननः स विज्ञेयः सांख्येभ्यः सिद्धिदायकः । लोमासुरप्रहर्ता वै आखुगश्च प्रकीर्तितः ॥८॥
records.notes: Important: original page48 actually reads लोमासुर, matching the supplied historical problematic quotation. Existing ಲೋಭಾಸುರ is retained provisionally as the narrative/editorial name choice identified in the packet; it is not scan-confirmed here. No independent narrative-name scan was inspected within this scope. Do not label the problem online-only or mechanically replace the current name with Lomasura. Sankhya recipients, siddhi-giving and mouse mount are supported.

records.before: ಲಂಬೋದರನು ಕ್ರೋಧಾಸುರನ ಸಂಹಾರಕನೆಂದು ಹೇಳಲ್ಪಟ್ಟಿದ್ದಾನೆ. ಶಕ್ತಿಬ್ರಹ್ಮವು ಸತ್‌ಸ್ವರೂಪವಾಗಿದ್ದು, ಮೂಷಕವಾಹನನಾದ ಅವನು ಅದರ ಆಧಾರವೆಂದು ಕರೆಯಲ್ಪಡುತ್ತಾನೆ. ॥೯॥
records.source_reading: लंबोदरावतारो वै क्रोधासुरनिबर्हणः । शक्तिब्रह्माखुगः सद्यत्तस्य धारक उच्यते ॥९॥
records.notes: The original confirms continuous शक्तिब्रह्माखुगः सद्यत्तस्य. आखुगः supports the mouse mount already present. The sat/junction and attachment remain compressed; existing sat wording is retained provisionally, not certified as settled. Context19.55 explicitly associates Shakti with asat-prakashaka, but that does not license inserting an absent अ or harmonizing20.9. No new minimal correction is justified without further philological/edition evidence.
